title: fisk-ai A2A v1 conversation read
description: Asks to be told what a conversation holds. The worker sends replay blocks of it, counted back from the end, between replay_start and replay_end status markers, and then ends the reply set. It takes no turn and calls no model, so it is answered whatever state the conversation is in and while a turn of it is in flight.

replay.description: How many blocks of the stored conversation to send, counted back from the end. At least one: a read of nothing is a resume, and the count is what separates the two. The worker rounds outwards to a turn boundary so a result never arrives without the call it answers, and sends at most 200.
